description: For an order whose crypto quote expired before a payment arrived (get_order_status says so): asks for a new quote, at a new exact amount with 20 minutes to send. It is the order page's GET A NEW QUOTE button. Refused while the current quote is still inside its 20 minutes (send against that one), once a payment to the order has been seen, and for an order no longer awaiting payment. No new code is emailed. Nothing is charged here: the buyer sends the payment from their own wallet. For an order crypto is not offered on, this tool answers that crypto is not offered for the order, and nothing changes.
name: request_new_quote
title: Get a new crypto quote after the last one expired
